_doc: Loading-screen and pause tips (UPDATE 09 section 7, DECISIONS T-144). `tips`: one shown per loading screen (LoadingScreen.pick_tip), each a single plain sentence or two, no brand names, under 140 characters. `lore_lines`: per map id, one line shown under the map's name while it loads (LoadingScreen.lore_line); in-world voice, the date where the story needs it. test_tips checks the counts, lengths and that every playable map has lines.
tips: Rebuilt boards pay Scrip. The early rounds are for building, not for heroics.
Sprint, then crouch to slide. Jump out of a slide to keep the speed.
Hold USE at a wall gun you already own to buy its ammunition.
The Crucible forges a gun three times: V, VV and VVV. Each forge costs more.
A violet glint on a hand or above a brow is the Marke. Hit it: it pays extra and drops them faster.
Headshots pay more Scrip than body kills. The Marke on the forehead counts as the head.
Perk slots are capped at six (four under Classic Rules). Pick the ones that fit the map.
A downed friend can crawl and shoot for forty-five seconds. Hold USE on them to bring them back.
Doors cost Scrip but open new ground, new walls of guns and new ways to run.
The bank keeps Scrip between matches. Its interest is small and honest, which is rare.
A kill now and then drops dog tags. Walk near them and they drift to you: free Scrip.
Grenades cook while you hold the button. Peg's trait shows the fuse on the HUD.
Every board you rebuild in a round pays, up to a cap. Stand back from the window while you do it.
The power switch opens the perk cabinets. Find it before round five if you can.
Bots buy their own guns and open doors with their own Scrip. Mark a task and they will see to it.
Pings on the pause map tell your squad where to go. Bots follow them too.
Ammo boxes refill the gun in your hands and your grenades, for a price. Every map has them.
A crate costs a fair price and gives an unfair gun, sometimes. Sometimes not.
Finish a round without taking a hit and the round pay comes with a bonus.
A crawler is still a zombie. Count it before you start the next round.
Double Scrip doubles every kill, every board and every Marke bonus while it lasts.
Relief squads fight beside you for a while. If one falls, the Marke gets him back up.
Wren earns ten Scrip more for every headshot kill. Aim for the hat.
Deacon repairs, builds and resets traps faster. Give him the boards.
Dutch hits harder with the knife. When the ammo runs out, he does not.
Classic Rules turns off traits and the Marke bonus for a straight fight.
The intel you find is kept in the Archive between matches. Read it: it is all true.
Challenges rotate. Finish one in a match and its reward is yours for good.
On a new map, walk it once before the round starts: windows, doors, the way out.
The account is never closed by them. You close it.

map04a>map04b: The ramp closed behind you. Nobody at Thalbach pressed the button.
Werk Thalbach falls away under the netting. The Kranich knows the way.
transition_lines._doc: U10 §3 Act III (T-157): the loading card's line for a campaign transition, keyed '<from map prefix>><to map prefix>' (LoadingScreen.transition_line); the map's own lore_lines otherwise.
map04b>map04c: The Kranich came down on a dry lake in Nevada at 05:41. The salt burned black for fifty metres. Nobody on the range had been told to expect her.
Down on the salt. The fire is still going. Something under a tarp in the hangar heard her land.
map04c>map04d: LANTERN cleared the gantry at 06:41 on a stolen engine and a burn read off a dead man's radio. Nobody on the range saw it come down, because it didn't.
Groom Lake fell away under them. The relay did not.

map00_crossroads: Gasthaus Zum Kreuzweg, 23 December 1944. The plane is down, the road is closed, and the dead are walking up from the south.
Frau Pohl's coffee is still warm on the table. Nobody has paid for it.
There is a man locked in the coal cage, and he is the only one here who has never been marked.
map01_kaltenbrunn: Kaltenbrunn, late December 1944. The salt mine kept the Ledger. The Ledger kept everyone.
Eleven went down the Maintenance Stairs. One came out.
The chapel is carved from salt. The prayers in it were not answered by anyone you would want.
map02_totenhafen: Totenhafen, January 1945. The pens flood every third round, and the cargo is still aboard U-1047.
Lead coffins for a Swiss consignee. Nobody ships lead that carefully unless something inside must stay down.
The tide comes in. The tide goes out. The dead do not care either way.
map04a_thalbach: Werk Thalbach, May 1945. The war is ending everywhere except here.
The night shift never clocked out. The clock is still running against them.
map04b_kranich: Der Kranich, over the Atlantic, May 1945. Nobody aboard is a passenger.
The autopilot knows the way. The question is whose way.
She lifted off from Werk Thalbach at 02:10 with the bay doors still open. Somebody had to close them from the inside.
map04c_groomlake: Groom Lake, May 1945. A dry lake, a rocket, and a contract nobody read to the end.
The desert is quiet. The relay above it is not.
She came down on the salt at dawn and slid two kilometres. The port engine room did not come with her.
map04d_mondlicht: The Moon, May 1945. Regional Retention Relay RR-7: the carrier that keeps the marked dead walking.
Every Marke on Earth answers to this place. Cut the line, and they all lie down.
LANTERN, capsule two: three days in the dark, and the relay's pad lights came on before anyone asked.
ending_kuendigung: The line is cut. On the Earth the violet goes out over the cities one by one, and the dead lie down where they stand.
Somewhere a record says Pohl, and Pilch, and every name read in. Nobody renews.
ending_renewed: The plan renewed itself. Nothing is required of you. Nothing is ever required of you again.
On the Earth the night side is violet from coast to coast. The relay thanks you for your continued engagement.
